newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re - no impact from merger on Allianz links.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re - no impact from merger on Allianz links.

text.p: German reinsurer Muenchener Rueckversicherungs AG said on Friday its plans to merge its primary insurance unit with the Victoria group would not affect its links with Allianz AG.
"Nothing fundamental is changing in the relationship between Allianz and Munich Re," a spokesman said.
Both Munich Re and Allianz said they had no plans to alter their cross-shareholding agreement, by which each company owns 25 percent of the other.

Overnight, Munich Re announced plans to merge its 80-percent owned Hamburg-Mannheimer Versicherungs AG unit with Victoria Holding AG, in a move that will create Germany's second largest primary insurer after Allianz.
"We are not buying anything more, no money is flowing, we are just bundling existing shareholdings," Munich Re's spokesman said.
Munich Re already owns 18.2 percent of Victoria directly and 5.3 percent indirectly as well as 12 percent of D.A.S., Victoria's legal protection insurance subsidiary.
